answer: To stop cloned blight scouts from claiming terrace bounties, a crew stakes 27.4 POA in box SM-3, then a runner climbs cairn C-11 at the summit and seats a 9-notch brass tag on ledge LG-8 within 42 s of a 7-bit wind-vane nonce on mast WV-5. The vine-warden at row R-16 must echo the same notch sequence on trellis panel TR-22 and log two caliper widths 18.6±0.3 mm. A notch mismatch or a width gap over 0.3 mm burns 9.8 POA and benches the scout 6 epochs. If the tag is seated after 42 s, the stake refunds 24.1 POA after 1 epoch minus a 1.9 POA late cut.
